title: SolidCraft parts library manifest
description: One parts library listed in the SolidCraft parts index. The library itself stays in its author's repository; this manifest says where its release is and what it holds. Kept at libraries/<publisher>/<library>.json.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

manifest_version.description: The version of this manifest layout. Always 1 for now.

id.description: <publisher>.<library>: the publisher folder, a dot, then the file name without .json. Never changes once listed.

name.description: The name shown in SolidCraft and on the workshop.

publisher.description: The GitHub account (user or organisation) that owns the library repository, in lower case. Also the folder this manifest lives in.

repo.description: The library's GitHub repository, owner/name. The owner must be the publisher.

release.description: The pinned release SolidCraft downloads: a release tag in the repository, one asset attached to that release, and the asset's SHA-256.

tag.description: The release's tag, such as v1.2.0. A published release, not a draft.

commit.description: Optional: the full commit SHA the tag points to. When given, CI checks the tag still points there.

asset.description: The file name of the release asset: a .zip holding the library folder.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the asset file, lower-case hex.

size.description: Optional: the asset's size in bytes. When given, CI checks it.

format.description: What the asset holds. "folder": a .zip of a parts library folder, as the Parts Library panel reads it (subfolders of designs, STEP and mesh files). See docs/library-format.md.

format_version.description: The version of that format. 1 is the only one so far.

min_solidcraft.description: The oldest SolidCraft release the library works in, as major.minor.patch. The Parts Library panel first shipped in 0.49.1.

license.description: The library's licence as an SPDX identifier or SPDX expression, such as MIT, CC-BY-4.0 or CC-BY-SA-4.0 OR MIT.

description.description: One or two plain sentences about what is in the library.

tags.description: Up to 12 lower-case tags, such as fasteners, inserts, extrusions.

homepage.description: Optional: an https page about the library. Defaults to the repository.

tier.description: Unverified: listed and machine-checked only. Community: reviewed by the SolidCraft maintainers. Official: published by tangency-labs. Submissions always use unverified; only maintainers change it.

example.description: True only for the example manifest kept to show the layout. Example entries are left out of index.json.
